t: This is St Clement Eastcheap, a Church of England parish church in Candlewick Ward of the City of London. You'll find it on Clement's Lane, off King William Street, close to London Bridge and the River Thames. The church was designed by Sir Christopher Wren. After the Great Fire of 1666 he was given responsibility for rebuilding fifty-two City churches, and he also designed St Paul's Cathedral on Ludgate Hill, completed in 1710. This is one of his smaller City churches, still in use as a parish church today.
